_comment: Cover rules (Shub, 3 Nov 2026): every cover shows the brand ambassador, an original warm AI butler, with an expression that suits the story. 'expressions' is his expression library (scripts/generate-ambassador.mjs). No seed: Workers AI FLUX schnell rejects it, so each render is a fresh face and the 'character' text is what keeps him consistent. Each expression's 'alt' is completed by src/lib/ambassador.ts as 'AI illustration: our butler, <alt>.'

styles.abstract: Abstract symbolic digital art, dark navy background (#0b0f1a), flowing geometric forms and particle fields in glowing cyan (#22d3ee) and violet (#a78bfa), a single amber (#fbbf24) accent that draws the eye, minimal, elegant, sense of tension, editorial cover art, generous empty space at the top
styles.gritty: Dark gritty editorial illustration, heavy shadows, cold harsh lighting, smoke and grain, ominous mood, deep navy and black palette with sickly cyan glow and a warning amber light, sense of threat and unease, dramatic low angle
styles.cinematic: Cinematic sci-fi digital illustration, dark navy background (#0b0f1a), glowing cyan (#22d3ee) and violet (#a78bfa) light, amber (#fbbf24) warning accents, volumetric light, high contrast, sense of scale and awe, editorial magazine cover art, clean composition with empty space at the top
styles.personified: Elegant stylised digital painting, premium graphic-novel cover art, soft cinematic lighting with gentle cyan and violet (#a78bfa) accents and a small amber (#fbbf24) highlight, dark navy background (#0b0f1a), appealing and approachable, not horror, not creepy, high detail on the face, clean magazine cover composition
styles.personified-gritty: Gritty cyberpunk digital painting, heavy shadows, grime and grain, harsh cold light, ominous mood, sickly cyan glow and a warning amber light, intense close-up

rules: stylised digital painting, clearly an illustration and not a photograph; an original fictional character who must not resemble any real person, actor or celebrity and must not depict any film or comic character; friendly and appealing, never creepy, horror or uncanny; no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no watermark or signature, no news-photo realism; no signs, no shop signs, no billboards, no screens with writing, plain softly blurred background
character: The recurring main character is the blog's brand ambassador, an ORIGINAL fictional AI butler: a warm, dignified East Asian man in his 40s, black hair neatly slicked back with a side part, thick dark eyebrows, warm brown eyes, clean-shaven, a calm kind face; he wears a black mandarin high-collar suit jacket over a pale grey shirt and a black tie; a single thin glowing cyan (#22d3ee) line at his right temple near the hairline; his right hand is a sleek smooth silver robotic hand, the only other machine detail. Head-and-shoulders portrait against a plain dark navy background, the face is the focus, looking towards the viewer

modelSheet: Full-body character reference for 3D modelling of an ORIGINAL fictional AI butler: a warm, dignified East Asian man in his 40s, black hair neatly slicked back with a side part, thick dark eyebrows, warm brown eyes, clean-shaven, calm kind face, gentle closed-mouth smile; black mandarin high-collar suit jacket over a pale grey shirt and a black tie, black trousers, black polished shoes; a single thin glowing cyan line at his right temple; his right hand is a sleek smooth silver robotic hand. Standing straight in a relaxed A-pose, arms held slightly away from the body, palms facing inward, feet shoulder-width apart, whole body visible from head to shoes and centred, facing the camera directly, front view, neutral even studio lighting, no cast shadows, plain flat light grey background, nothing else in the frame. Semi-realistic digital painting, soft brush strokes, clean silhouette
characterFemale: Art, the blog's ORIGINAL fictional AI host: a confident woman in her early 30s; long straight-to-wavy dark brunette hair with a natural side part and no fringe or bangs falling past her shoulders; hazel-green eyes; faint freckles; defined brows; understated polished makeup in neutral tones; a small matte carbon-fibre plate with a thin glowing cyan line at her right temple. She wears a sleek long-sleeved black ribbed stretch-jersey mini dress with a high mock neck and a vertical lace-up placket with silver grommets down the front, laced fully closed and tied at the waist; fully covered high neckline with no cutouts, no keyhole, no buttons. Her left hand, emerging from the sleeve, is a polished chrome and matte-black robotic hand. Confident, relaxed, elegant pose; tasteful fashion-editorial portrait, non-sexualised. Three-quarter length framing from head to mid-thigh, face clearly visible, plain dark navy background
styleFemale: One consistent art style in every image: semi-realistic digital oil painting, visible soft painterly brushwork, gently stylised but realistic proportions, soft cinematic lighting with subtle cyan and violet rim light; NOT a photograph, NOT photorealistic, NOT a cartoon, NOT anime, NOT 3D render
